name: runlight-monorepo
description: Runlight: privacy friendly web analytics that lives inside your app.

scripts.test: npm run check:dashes && npm test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:scripts && node --import tsx scripts/php-assets.mts --check && node --import tsx scripts/python-assets.mts --check && node --import tsx scripts/ruby-assets.mts --check && node --import tsx scripts/go-assets.mts --check && node scripts/go-casing.mjs --check && node scripts/go-intl.mjs --check && node --import tsx scripts/elixir-assets.mts --check && node --import tsx scripts/elixir-intl.mts --check && node --import tsx scripts/java-assets.mts --check && node --import tsx scripts/java-intl.mts --check && node --import tsx scripts/java-collation.mts --check && node --import tsx scripts/dotnet-assets.mts --check && node scripts/dotnet-intl.mjs --check && node --import tsx scripts/rust-assets.mts --check
scripts.build: npm run check:dashes && npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run php-assets && npm run python-assets && npm run ruby-assets && npm run go-assets && npm run elixir-assets && npm run java-assets && npm run dotnet-assets && npm run rust-assets
scripts.check: npm run check:dashes && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:php
